gates.title: Production asset and font policy: provenance, generated assets, derivative maps, package inclusion
gates.evidence_prerequisite: Accepted TASK-0093 typography audit and TASK-0094 asset provenance inventory; a playable side-by-side comparison of procedural presentation versus candidate plates/fonts at supported resolutions (1920x1080, 1366x768).
gates.critical_path_deadline: Before any UNKNOWN/BLOCKED production asset or font promotion and before packaging (terminal gates T6 and T7). Procedural placeholders remain valid meanwhile.
gates.recommended_evidence_gathering_step: Accept the 0093/0094 inventories, then stage a capturable playable comparison of candidate plates/fonts with recorded source, license/rights, SHA-256, dimensions, derivative instructions, and named package consumer; unknown external plates stay reference-only.
gates.packet_recommendation: OI-003 recommends shipping only repository-tracked assets with recorded source, license/rights, SHA-256, dimensions, derivative instructions, and named package consumer. This is a documented packet recommendation, not an owner ruling.
viable_decision_classes: Owner-created originals under the same manifest discipline (source, license, SHA-256, dimensions, derivatives recorded).
Licensed third-party pack/font with archived license and attribution terms.

Owner-generated asset executed only under an exact generation-packet protocol (prompt/instructions, pixel dimensions, color-space/alpha needs, lossless PNG source filename, target folder, collision/normal/mask/atlas derivatives, acceptance rubric) when such a packet exists.
Continue procedural/vector-first presentation per D-113 until a plate/font set is approved; reject undocumented copying and implicit AI-generation rights in every class.
acceptance_rubric: Provenance, license/rights, SHA-256, dimensions, and derivative instructions recorded in the shippable asset manifest.
Stable IDs/versioning and named migration impact for every promoted asset.
Readability/play verdict at default path in both supported resolutions.
No undocumented copying; no implicit AI-generation rights assumed.
No legacy firewall regression (no Delaford-era assets return).
dependent_tasks_gates: Stage-2 renderer asset needs (after renderer dependency ruling, see out-of-scope cross-reference OI-002)
Terminal gate T5 final presentation and T6 owner-approved content
fallback_work: Procedural/vector presentation continues (D-113 near-term aesthetic stands).
TASK-0093/0094 audit and manifest work continues.
